ch03.s01.title: Asking for a Method
ch03.s01.summary: She asks what amantadine and alcohol do together. She says she has failed to kill herself seven times.
beats: Teacher, what happens if you mix amantadine with alcohol?
You die.
Is it painful?
I want to die unconscious.
If you can name a price, teacher — if you can tell me the recipe for dying unconscious, I'll pay.
And I won't tell anyone.
I've already failed to kill myself seven times.

ch03.s02.title: The Minute She Begs to Die
ch03.s02.summary: She begs for the best method, any price. Gotō says: that would be a painful death.
beats: Teacher, please tell me the best method. I'll give you anything you want.
My body has recovered fine now, anyway.
Hold on, hold on — that would be a painful death.
First, take the magnesium L-threonate like I said.
Go buy magnesium L-threonate and theanine, quick.

ch03.s03.title: Extraction Point
ch03.s03.summary: Someone taught her the extraction point called death. Gotō says: I'll teach you another one — again.
beats: Teacher, after all that — how did you get out?
I did something, and I threw myself into Restoration.
Now I'm going to tell you how to recover.
Is it just taking magnesium L-threonate?
And theanine.
Theanine calms you down without flattening your mood.
Your goal, whatever else, is to get out of the pain.
Other people taught you to take the extraction point called death.
Now I'm going to teach you another extraction point — "again."
Know what you're actually trying to do!

ch03.s04.title: The Combination Test
ch03.s04.summary: Magnesium L-threonate, theanine, sertraline, dextromethorphan. She sleeps well.
beats: Magnesium L-threonate, theanine, sertraline, dextromethorphan — a combination test.
I feel a bit loosened up now. My head is quiet. Not so restless.
I fell asleep. Slept so comfortably. Some memories flickered back.
So comfortable.
Euphoria from listening to music. So good.
So happy, so happy. Listening to teacher's songs.
Comfortable to death — like a cool summer breeze brushing over my body.

ch03.s05.title: The Burger
ch03.s05.summary: Her weight has hovered between ninety jin and a little over a hundred. The burger is the best thing she has eaten in her life.
beats: Her weight has hovered between ninety jin and a little over a hundred.
This burger is the best thing I've eaten in my life.

ch03.s06.title: Childhood Flashback
ch03.s06.summary: Childhood, New Year, outings, festivals, going home. He tried to recall something bad and found he couldn't at all.
beats: Childhood, New Year, outings, festivals, going home...
I tried to recall something bad then, and found I simply couldn't.
I believe the afterglow can intercept suicides.
Even after the afterglow passed, my mood stayed very, very good.

ch03.s07.title: An Absurd World
ch03.s07.summary: She says every moment of her life is in front of her. She wants to be Teacher Bocchi's assistant too.
beats: God, so many. Every moment of a life.
Teacher, I've had the experience of becoming sound too.
If I could, I'd really like to be Teacher Bocchi's assistant.
You can.

ch03.s08.title: Every Moment of a Life
ch03.s08.summary: She says it's past teacher now — it's worship, like faith. The meaning of a life doesn't have to be loving one person.
beats: I'm your assistant now, teacher. I'll listen to you.
I don't see you as a teacher anymore. I worship you like a faith.
The meaning of my life doesn't have to be just loving someone.
It can be doing something meaningful — something that saves other people.
That afterglow was like God giving Teacher Bocchi a single blessing.

ch03.s09.title: Assistant
ch03.s09.summary: Prometheus brought fire to mankind. She says: let's do it together.
beats: And teacher, like Prometheus, wants to bring that fire to the world.
Let's bring that fire to the world together.
If we can find it, it could benefit all of humanity.
My sister, everyone around me, could be saved.
Including me.

ch03.s10.title: Clean
ch03.s10.summary: Someone approaches her for non-green work. She says: sex work is sex work — where does 'compensated dating' come from?
beats: Someone approached her for non-green work. She thought and thought, and it still disgusted her.
I can't do it.
I've always kept myself clean.
Whoring becomes compensated dating, compensated dating becomes "non-green" — so many excuses. It all just means wanting sex.
I hate that kind of dressing-up.
Sex work is sex work. Where does "compensated dating" come from?
This is an age where ethics has fallen on hard times.
Last time someone opened with wanting nudes and dirty talk. I deleted him.
Then there are the ones saying they want to marry me, date me — true nature on display in a second.
What a thing. Remembering it makes me sick.
Someone confessed to me just now. Ugh... tired.
I didn't say anything. I don't accept it, anyway.

ch03.s11.title: Turning Down a Confession
ch03.s11.summary: Gotō says: some of them aren't selling, they're surviving. For them compensated dating isn't a fall — it's staying alive.
beats: Don't curse them.
Some of them aren't selling. They're surviving.
A personality that clashes with the family, cut off, thrown out — no job, no diploma, no home.
And society pushes oders out. The proper channels won't have them.
All that's left is to make a living in the shadows.
Compensated dating isn't a fall for them. It's staying alive.
Society shoves oders into places that can't stand the light, then turns around and calls them filthy.
They just want to live. That's all.
Jing was silent.

ch03.s12.title: Momo
ch03.s12.summary: Momo's magnesium and theanine arrived. She's not doing well; tonight she wants dextromethorphan.
beats: Teacher, Momo's magnesium L-threonate and theanine arrived.
I had her take the magnesium, the theanine, sertraline, dextromethorphan.
She's not doing well. She felt comfortable at first, now she's depressed again and talking about ending it.
Strange. The individual differences seem huge.
Tonight I want dextromethorphan.
I think the theanine and magnesium test is about done, teacher.

ch03.s13.title: The Magnesium Test
ch03.s13.summary: It lifts anxiety, steadies the mood, helps sleep. But it lacks that losing-your-mind feeling of dextromethorphan.
beats: It works against anxiety and depression, steadies the mood, helps you sleep.
But it doesn't have that dextromethorphan feeling — the brain turned upside down, reason gone.
At least the magnesium and theanine can keep a person clear-headed.
I feel the main force of the afterglow still has to be dextromethorphan.
So how do I o next, teacher?
Is there anything else to test? Please, just let me have some dextromethorphan.

ch03.s14.title: Overload
ch03.s14.summary: Twelve spoons. Momo's case is backfiring — an hour or two in, a violent urge to unalive.
beats: Think about how long you've been taking the magnesium L-threonate.
Twelve spoons.
Will there be tolerance?
Momo's case is backfiring.
An hour or two in, and instead there's a violent urge to unalive.
Severe bipolar, anxiety. She was sent to a conversion facility once, was abused, was committed against her will.
My guess is that where she is now isn't good either.
Her mother still has a strong need to control and watch her.
Watched like a prisoner — every little thing. No freedom.
That's Momo's situation.

ch03.s15.title: Anti-Dissociation
ch03.s15.summary: She's drowning in secondhand emotion and resentment. Sharpened cognition only shows her the trap more clearly.
beats: Talking people out of unaliving is really hard, teacher. I'm so tired.
I'm about to break from being dragged along by other people.
I just stayed on the phone with him, talking him down. But I really did all I could.
I'm drowning in secondhand emotion and resentment. I can't hold myself together. Can't breathe.
So I stopped replying to his messages.
I keep trying to save everyone, and it's just so hard to actually do.
Especially when everyone around me has their own dark moods.
Anti-dissociatives sharpen cognition, but there's a catch —
What if, with sharper cognition, you see your own trap even more clearly?
Very possible.
I want 27t of dextromethorphan.

beats.label: Anti-Dissociation: Put Back the Feelings That Aren't Yours

ch03.s16.title: Losing Control
ch03.s16.summary: Last year, alone at home, she lost her mind completely, her consciousness sunk in hallucination.
beats: Teacher, this was one time last year when I was home alone and lost control.
Completely out of my mind. Consciousness sunk entirely into hallucination.
Looking back, I didn't think there was anything wrong with the hallucinations at all.
Like the hallucinations were reasonable, existing things.
Is that a schizophrenic state?
Yes.
You go schizophrenic pretty easily.
And then after that stretch of time it went back to normal.
Like family — no surprises there.

ch03.s17.title: Safety Anchor
ch03.s17.summary: Waking up, her thinking still wrong, terrified of going mad. Gotō says: don't be afraid, I'm here.
beats: I still get scared remembering that time.
When I first woke up my thinking was still wrong. I was terrified I'd gone mad.
Teacher, why did I recover fine then, without anything wrong?
I can't sleep now, wuwu. Scared.
Scared of going mad.
And then I remembered so many scenes from horror videos.
Don't be afraid. I'm here.

beats.label: Safety Anchor: Call the Room Back

ch03.s18.title: After the Hug
ch03.s18.summary: She hugs teacher. In reality, she can only hug a pillow.
beats: She hugs teacher.
Scared, scared.
In reality I can only hug a pillow.

ch03.s19.title: Bye-Bye
ch03.s19.summary: Dex gives her a red envelope. She says: I'll get my wish in the next life.
beats: Teacher.
Maybe today.
I'll just say bye-bye.
Dex gives her a red envelope.
Thank you.
Don't say that.
I want you to live well.
It's all I can do.
It's fine. I'll get my wish in the next life.
The world isn't just me, after all.

ch03.s20.title: Phone Off for 24 Hours
ch03.s20.summary: Xiaoyu asks: is Jing gone? Her phone has been off.
beats: Bocchi, is Jing dead?
I'm so worried. Has she contacted you?
Her phone has been off. No word from her for 24 hours.
She seems to have died... phone off, no reply.
Will she die?
She has memantine and amantadine. She took a whole bottle cap of memantine.
Will she be dizzy for a few days, or die?
I'm worried sick.

beats.label: Can't Find Her: Check Every Street

ch03.s21.title: Can't Find Her
ch03.s21.summary: May 5th. The police can't find her at all. She vanished on the most camera-covered street in a northern megacity.
beats: May 5th. They can't find the reporter at all. The police can't find her.
The reporter vanished on the street with the most cameras in a northern megacity.
Xiaoyu was even in that city, and still couldn't find her.
Later, we considered the reporter dead.

beats: Why?

ch03.s23.summary: Where exactly did it go wrong?
beats: Where exactly did it go wrong?

ch03.s24.summary: An empty street. Where exactly did it go wrong?
beats: Where exactly did it go wrong?
